title: Move toward without overshooting
prompt: Move x toward target at speed, but never past it. Return the new x.
signature: func solve(x: float, target: float, speed: float, delta: float) -> float:
starter:
func solve(x: float, target: float, speed: float, delta: float) -> float:
	return x + speed * delta
hint: Godot has move_toward(from, to, step). The step is how far you may go this frame.
solution:
func solve(x: float, target: float, speed: float, delta: float) -> float:
	return move_toward(x, target, speed * delta)
